g.text: Built on local cache · zero extra Moodle requests
Coursework transformed into checkable, prioritized tasks
✓ Docker image built · IAM policy check needed
FIT5225 · Trivy static analysis & Dockerfile hardening
Interactive cards update seamlessly when Moodle coursework changes
Instant answers cited directly to lecture slides & assignment briefs
What are the IAM security rules for Assignment 2?
Grounded in FIT5225 Week 6 materials & project specification
Restrict ECS task execution roles strictly to S3 read
Hardcoded DB passwords in env vars are strictly prohibited
by rubric Section 3.2 (-5% penalty if detected).
Inbound port 5432 must be restricted to ALB SG only,
Generated locally · OpenAI compatible · zero cloud sync
✓ 100% verified against official Monash unit courseware
Streaming output types live, fully Markdown rendered with verified citations
